messages:
talia: Heads-up — we need to align on new continuous-batching metrics for the Console. Goal: batch size distribution, wait-time shape (p50/p90/p99 + histogram), saturation indicators, and quota-driven routing signals. Who from runtime/infra can share what signals we can reliably surface?

derek: runtime: we can emit `batch.size_histogram`, `batch.fill_rate`, `batch.wait_ms.p50/p90/p99`, `kv_cache.hit_rate`, and `dispatch.backpressure` today. p99 for tiny tenants is noisy.

ravi: infra: we can add `queue.saturation_pct`, `node.available_gpus`, and tag by `capacity_tier`. For per-tenant quota headroom we need tenant-level metrics: `quota.tokens_remaining` and `quota.replenish_rate`. Cardinality will be the main cost.

sarah: console-ux: want a heatmap panel for waitshape by model+route and a tiny sparkline for saturation. Also can we create a derived `predicted_drop_risk` metric? UI needs 1-min granularity.

alex: product: predicted_drop_risk would be used to trigger routing fallbacks. How do we compute it and how reliable will it be?

derek: we can approximate risk as a cheap rollup: risk = sigmoid((fill_rate_last_min / target_throughput) * (saturation_pct / 100)). Cheap to compute in TSDB rollups. Will need to pick a smoothing window.

ravi: TSDB cost note: high-cardinality derived metrics explode. Propose to compute `predicted_drop_risk` aggregated at route+model+region (primary) and keep raw per-tenant only for sampled top-k to avoid cardinality blowup.

talia: tradeoff accepted. UX: aggregated per-route is primary, but we must support drilldown to the top 10 tenants by risk. Can infra emit top-k lists or should UI query on demand?

ravi: easier to emit `top_risk_tenants` as a compact JSON blob to our events/rollup bucket once per minute. We'll cap at top 10 and size-limit it.

ops-bot: deploy: metric rollout requirements: new deployment tag `batch-metrics-v1` and feature flag `ui.batch_waitshape` toggled to 10% initially. Add rollout playbook entry.

sarah: UX: feature flag fine. Panel requirements: histogram controls, overlay `quota_headroom` bands, sample count, and a confidence indicator. Example query snippet for the backend:

```
metrics.filter{name="batch.wait_ms" and model="*"} | quantile(0.9) by (route)
```

derek: also send `batch.batch_size_buckets` histogram from runtime so UI can render distribution without heavy ad-hoc queries.

alex: routing question: when risk > 0.8 should the router fallback to a cheaper model or to reserved/dedicated pool? Need policy options documented.

talia: proposed policy: default fallback -> compatible cheaper model. If `quota_headroom` is low and `risk > 0.95` -> route to dedicated reserved pool (if available), else enqueue. We'll make thresholds configurable per-customer.

ravi: note: quota token updates have up to ~20s latency. We should surface metric latency and advise conservative thresholds in the UI.

derek: also note sampling: very small tenants will have unstable p99s. UI should display `sample_count` and gray out low-confidence cells.

sarah: will add sample_count overlays and a confidence tooltip. We'll also add a compact drilldown flow: click route -> shows top_k tenants blob + tenant-level sparkline (last 15m).

sarah: we need a backend endpoint to power the dashboard: `GET /internal/metrics/ui-rollups?routes=...&window=1m`. Return aggregated series and top_k JSON.

ravi: we can expose that behind internal auth. Response shape: `route, model, ts, p50, p90, p99, fill_rate, saturation_pct, top_risk_tenants_json` (we'll compress the JSON).

talia: action items (summary): infra: add tenant quota tokens metric + rollup endpoint (ravi). runtime: ensure size_histogram + wait_ms buckets + batch_size_buckets (derek). infra: emit top_k blob once/min (ravi). ops: create deploy tag + flag (ops-bot). UX: mock panels + wireframes (sarah). product: finalize fallback thresholds and config (alex). I'll draft an oncall playbook for this dashboard.

derek: ETA for runtime changes: ~2 weeks (will split into small PRs).

ravi: infra ETA: ~10 days for quota metric + rollup endpoint, but will need a migration to limit cardinality and add sampling.

sarah: UX ETA: 1 week for mock panels and initial prototype.

alex: product ETA: 1 week to propose thresholds; current leaning: risk>0.8 -> cheap-model fallback, risk>0.95 -> dedicated if available.

talia: ok. Can we meet Wed 11am for a 30m sync? I'll schedule recurring every week for the first two weeks.

derek: 👍

ravi: 👍

sarah: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: created feature flag `ui.batch_waitshape` (10% canary) and ticket INF-412 for rollout.

talia: thanks everyone — I'll paste the draft playbook and the first wireframe in this thread tomorrow.
